title: Claims Interest Rate Table: Delayed Death Claim Payments on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Death claim interest on an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities death benefit share paid some weeks after the valuation date is worked at a higher claim interest base rate.

**Rule.** The claim interest base rate is **5% (0.05)** where payment is made more than **45** days after the valuation date, and **4% (0.04)** where payment is made more than **30** but no more than 45 days after the valuation date. Where payment is made 30 days or fewer after the valuation date, neither of these rates applies. Days are calendar days from the valuation date to the payment date.

| Days from the valuation date to payment | Claim interest base rate under this table |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | Neither rate applies |
| 31 to 45 | 4% |
| 46 or more | 5% |

**Edges (hypothetical, valuation date 1 March).** Payment on 31 March (30 days): neither rate. Payment on 1 April (31 days): 4%. Payment on 15 April (45 days): 4%. Payment on 16 April (46 days): 5%.
